info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Calendar Entries API
Return the data for all CalendarEntries

params.name: calendar_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Calendar. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the CalendarEntry records with the matching property.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter CalendarEntry records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: expanded
params.description: Returns a record for each occurrence of a recurring calendar event.  Non-recurring calendar events are unaffected and returned as separate records regardless of the expanded setting.

params.name: external_property_name
params.description:
Filter records to only those with the given external property(s) name set.

e.g. `?external_property_name=Name`

params.name: external_property_value
params.description:
Filter records to only those with the given external property(s) value set. Requires external property name as well.

e.g. `?external_property_name=Name&external_property_value=Value`

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: from
params.description: Filter CalendarEntry records to those that end on or after the provided time (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: has_court_rule
params.description: Allows matching court rule on calendar entry.

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter CalendarEntry records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: is_all_day
params.description: Filter CalendarEntry records to those that are marked as all day events.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of CalendarEntry records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Matter. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a CalendarEntry. The list will be filtered to include only the CalendarEntry records with the matching property.

params.name: owner_entries_across_all_users
params.description: Returns CalendarEntry records for all users related to a matter. Requires matter id.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: query
params.description: Allows matching search on calendar entry.

params.name: source
params.description: Filter CalendarEntry records to those having a specific calendar visibility source (mobile, web).

params.name: to
params.description: Filter CalendarEntry records to those that begin on or before the provided time (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter CalendarEntry records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: visible
params.description: Filter CalendarEntry records to those that are visible.
